about: {name} is a consumer cab service for outstation, one-way, airport and local rides.
description: {name} case study: a website with a fare and booking search, a mobile booking flow, social ad posters, a Meta ad and a Google search ad.
kind: Consumer service, outstation and local cab rides
brief: {name} offers outstation, one-way, airport and local rides. We built its website around a fare and booking search, with a matching mobile booking flow.
The booking search is the first thing on the page, because it is the one thing a visitor comes to do. The ads and posters use the same mascot and colours.

showcases.title: Homepage with booking search
showcases.text: A full-width road scene, a ride-type selector for one way, round trip, airport and local, and the pick-up and drop fields in one row.

showcases.title: Mobile booking flow
showcases.text: The same choices stacked for a phone, ending in the cab list.

showcases.title: Social ad creative
showcases.text: Two portrait posters for weekend trips and airport rides.

showcases.title: A Meta ad and a Google search ad
showcases.text: The Meta ad lists routes with a per-kilometre rate. The Google ad answers a search for outstation cabs.
